mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.product_id, s.sku_code, s.spec_name, s.weight_gram, s.price_fen, s.enabled, s.version FROM product_sku s JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.product_id JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE s.id = #{skuId} AND s.enabled = 1 AND p.status = 'ON_SALE' AND c.enabled = 1
SELECT id,product_id,sku_code,spec_name,weight_gram,price_fen,enabled,version FROM product_sku WHERE product_id=#{productId} AND enabled=1 ORDER BY id
SELECT id,product_id,sku_code,spec_name,weight_gram,price_fen,enabled,version FROM product_sku WHERE product_id=#{productId} ORDER BY id FOR SHARE
